Name: Early Ginger Island
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Access the Ginger Island early, depending on your friendship with Willy. Optionally access the Ginger Island west/farm, too. Configure the boat fix materials, ticket price and Golden Walnut requirements.[/size]

By default, you will be able to access Ginger Island:
[list][*]Anytime, if you have 8 hearts with Willy,
[*]In Winter, Year 1, if you have 4 hearts with Willy,
[*]In Winter, Year 2, no matter how many hearts with Willy you have,
[*]As always, after completing the Community Center.
[/list]
[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/EarlyGingerIsland]here[/url].

Manifest.Name: Early Ginger Island
Manifest.Description: Unlocks the Ginger Island early and/or reduces the costs of tickets or unlocking it.
Manifest.Author: Shockah
